summary: Harney County BLM lookout built 1964; older listings say emergency use, but a May 2022 visit found it uninhabitable, unstaffed and camera-monitored. No fire history found.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register and firelookout.com describe emergency availability; the May 2022 visit found it no longer staffed and uninhabitable. The story gives the 2022 finding and attributes the older claims.
Register coordinates (43.1002, -118.49913) are used. A second database in the brief places the site about 1.3 km to the northwest; not checked against a map.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the four sources give the build year, owner and a 2022 condition report, but no fire history, no later repairs and no move or rental. Access is recorded as restricted because of gates on the BLM road and the uninhabitable building; no closure notice was found, so this is an inference. The brief's coordinates match the Register. The building is not recommended for entry.
